basic_details.job_title: BMC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Program Coordinator, DEO Posts
basic_details.short_information: Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (बृहन्मुंबई महानगरपालिका), Public Health Department, has invited applications for 3 contract posts in its Non-Communicable Diseases (NCD) section: 1 Program Coordinator and 2 Data Entry Operators. The application form with documents must be submitted in person or by post to Ward No. 38, Kasturba Hospital, Chinchpokli, Mumbai – 400011, from 19 November 2026 to 5:00 PM on 26 November 2026. Applications arriving after 5:00 PM on 26 November 2026 will not be considered.

qualification.details: Age limit: 35 years; retired employees 62 years (age counted as on 01.09.2026). Essential: MBBS or another medical degree (BAMS / BHMS / BDS) recognised by the Maharashtra Medical Council or the National Medical Council. Essential: certificate of passing MS-CIT, or the computer/IT exam certificate mentioned in Government Resolution No. मातंस/2012/प्र.क्र.277/39 dated 04.02.2013 and its supplementary letters dated 08.01.2018 and 16.07.2018. Circulars later issued by the Maharashtra Directorate of Information Technology and adopted by BMC will apply. Preference: postgraduate in Public Health / Health Administration (Diploma/Masters in Public Health/DHA/CHA). Preference: at least one year of experience in a national health programme in a public or semi-government institution. Preference: experience in an equivalent post in BMC. | Age limit: 45 years (age counted as on 01.09.2026). Essential: graduate in any branch. Essential: passed the Secondary School Certificate exam or equivalent or higher exam with Marathi (higher/lower level) as a subject having a 100-mark paper. Essential: certificate of passing MS-CIT, or the computer/IT exam certificate mentioned in the same Government Resolution and supplementary letters as above. Essential: typing course of 6 months or more from a government-recognised institute, with the Maharashtra State Government certificate. Expected speed: Marathi 30 wpm, English 40 wpm, and data entry speed of 8000 key depressions. Knowledge of MS Word, Excel and computer systems for basic statistical techniques is required, along with the ability to do computer programming of various types. Preference: experience in an equivalent post in BMC. | The notice does not list any age relaxation by category. For the exact eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: About BMC
content_sections.text: Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation is the municipal body of Mumbai. This notice comes from its Public Health Department. The posts sit in the Non-Communicable Diseases department, whose office is at Ward No. 38, Kasturba Hospital, Chinchpokli. The posts are filled purely on a temporary contract basis with the approval of the Municipal Commissioner and the Executive Health Officer (approval No. HO/628/NCD, dated 18.11.2026).

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must fill in the form annexed to the notice with accurate information, attach all relevant documents and submit it in person or by post before the deadline. The form is addressed to the Deputy Executive Health Officer (NCD), Ward 38, Kasturba Hospital, Chinchpokli, Mumbai. Postal address: Ward No. 38, Ground Floor, Non-Communicable Diseases Department, Kasturba Hospital, opposite Arthur Road Jail, Sant Sane Guruji Marg, Chinchpokli, Mumbai – 400011. Take the prescribed application form (नमुना) given with the notice; the notice says details and the form are also displayed on the BMC website, in leading newspapers and on notice boards. Write the form by hand, completely, in the prescribed format. Forms not in the prescribed format or incomplete will not be considered. Stick a recent passport-size photograph in the space on the form and sign over the photograph. Attach the documents listed under Enclosures below. Submit the application at the address above in person or by post so that it is in time by 5:00 PM on 26 November 2026. The notice displays the details on the notice boards of two offices: the 3rd Floor, F/South Ward Office, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Marg, Parel, Mumbai 400012, and Ward No. 38, NCD Department, Kasturba Hospital, Chinchpokli – 400011, from 19.11.2026 to 26.11.2026. The notice does not give an envelope superscription or a postal mode.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Age limit: 35 years; retired employees 62 years (age counted as on 01.09.2026). Essential: MBBS or another medical degree (BAMS / BHMS / BDS) recognised by the Maharashtra Medical Council or the National Medical Council. Essential: certificate of passing MS-CIT, or the computer/IT exam certificate mentioned in Government Resolution No. मातंस/2012/प्र.क्र.277/39 dated 04.02.2013 and its supplementary letters dated 08.01.2018 and 16.07.2018. Circulars later issued by the Maharashtra Directorate of Information Technology and adopted by BMC will apply. Preference: postgraduate in Public Health / Health Administration (Diploma/Masters in Public Health/DHA/CHA). Preference: at least one year of experience in a national health programme in a public or semi-government institution. Preference: experience in an equivalent post in BMC. Age limit: 45 years (age counted as on 01.09.2026). Essential: graduate in any branch. Essential: passed the Secondary School Certificate exam or equivalent or higher exam with Marathi (higher/lower level) as a subject having a 100-mark paper. Essential: certificate of passing MS-CIT, or the computer/IT exam certificate mentioned in the same Government Resolution and supplementary letters as above. Essential: typing course of 6 months or more from a government-recognised institute, with the Maharashtra State Government certificate. Expected speed: Marathi 30 wpm, English 40 wpm, and data entry speed of 8000 key depressions. Knowledge of MS Word, Excel and computer systems for basic statistical techniques is required, along with the ability to do computer programming of various types. Preference: experience in an equivalent post in BMC. The notice does not list any age relaxation by category. For the exact eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application form SSC marksheet and certificate HSC marksheet and certificate Degree marksheet and certificate Postgraduate marksheet and certificate Additional degree/diploma/certificate MS-CIT certificate / computer certificate Typing certificate Experience certificate The application form also asks for name (surname first), father's/husband's full name, maiden name for women, correspondence address, gender, date of birth, mobile number, e-mail ID, educational details starting with the latest exam, whether the candidate has MS-CIT or the prescribed computer certificate, whether the candidate has the Marathi 30 wpm and English 40 wpm typing certificate (for Data Entry Operator), and the full address of the local police station. It ends with a declaration of the truth of the information.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: BMC will scrutinise the documents submitted and call eligible candidates for an interview in due course. Selection is by the marking-system criteria of the notice. After the interview, a selection list and a waiting list will be prepared and displayed on the notice board, and appointment orders will be given to the selected candidates. The notice does not give the interview date or the marks scheme.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are there in the BMC NCD recruitment?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts: 1 Program Coordinator and 2 Data Entry Operators in the Non-Communicable Diseases department of the Public Health Department.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 26 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM. Applications arriving after 5:00 PM that day will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Program Coordinator?
faq.answer: MBBS or another medical degree (BAMS / BHMS / BDS) recognised by the Maharashtra Medical Council or National Medical Council, plus an MS-CIT or equivalent computer certificate. Public health postgraduates are preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: A graduate in any branch who passed SSC or equivalent with Marathi, holds MS-CIT or equivalent and has a typing certificate. Required speeds are Marathi 30 wpm, English 40 wpm and 8000 key depressions for data entry.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: For Program Coordinator it is 35 years (retired employees 62 years); for Data Entry Operator it is 45 years. Age is counted as on 01.09.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Program Coordinator gets Rs. 40,000 per month and Data Entry Operator Rs. 18,000 per month. No other allowances are paid.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for BMC Program Coordinator or Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed form, attach the listed documents and submit them in person or by post to Ward No. 38, Kasturba Hospital, Chinchpokli, Mumbai – 400011.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Documents are scrutinised, eligible candidates are called for an interview, and selection is by the marking-system criteria. A selection list and a waiting list are then displayed on the notice board.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job and how long is the contract?
faq.answer: No. It is a purely temporary contract for 179 days up to 31.03.2027, ending automatically after that date. Contract staff cannot claim regular BMC service.

faq.question: Q10. Do contract staff get leave?
faq.answer: They get Sunday as weekly off and public holidays applicable to hospital staff, and casual leave in proportion for 179 days as per BMC practice.
